summary.short: Royal Decree 729/2023 approves the statute of the Spanish AI Supervision Agency (AESIA), a public-law entity under the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Digital Transformation, in force from 3 September 2023. It sets its governance and budget and empowers it to supervise AI systems, promote test environments and run voluntary certification.
summary.long: Royal Decree 729/2023 of 22 August approves the Statute of the Agencia Española de Supervisión de Inteligencia Artificial (AESIA), a public-law entity attached to the Secretariat of State for Digitalisation and Artificial Intelligence. The Statute sets the agency's legal regime, seat in A Coruña, and competences. Within State competence, the agency performs supervision and, where applicable, sanction of AI systems, promotes regulated test environments, operates a voluntary certification framework for private entities, and carries out awareness and training activities. Its governing bodies are the Presidency, a Governing Board and a Control Commission; its executive bodies are a Directorate, two sub-directorates and a General Secretariat. The agency is financed by State transfers and its own revenues, and operates under a four-year management contract. The agency's sub-directorate issues impact assessments on AI systems used by public administrations. The decree also sets staffing rules and transitional provisions, including that the Governing Board is to be constituted within three months of entry into force.

notes: Single consolidated BOE text (initial text published 02/09/2023; no later amendments appear in the document). target_instrument_id is left empty because no registry IDs were supplied. The preamble cites a Commission-era proposal for the EU AI regulation without a final citation. Drafting points: art. 24.6 substitutes executive organs enumerated in arts. 24, 25 and 26, but arts. 25 and 26 list departments within subdirectorates; art. 23.1 says the Dirección depends on the Presidencia, while art. 24.1.a sets management under Ministry guidelines. The preamble cites an authorisation in Ley 22/2021, while artículo único relies on Ley 28/2022 disposición adicional séptima.

thresholds.measurement: Outstanding balance (saldo vivo) of credit or loan facilities, relative to the Agency's budget (presupuesto)
thresholds.consequence: The Agency may take out credit or loan facilities to cover temporary treasury mismatches only while the outstanding balance does not exceed this share of its budget.
thresholds.conditions: Applies only to temporary treasury mismatches (desfases temporales de tesorería); the Agency otherwise may not borrow.
